text:
kelsey: FYI canary promo for search-service stopped during deploybot prefetch. Error shows manifest checksum mismatch vs cache. Promo paused.

deploy-bot: [status] prefetch failed service=search shard=0 reason=manifest-checksum-mismatch artifact=search:sha256:aa11...bb22. No fallback blob found.

ben: That sounds like a registry consistency window. Could be a rewrite of manifest after initial upload.

kelsey: Can we force-promote? We have a strict change window and need to know risk.

ben: Don't force. If the manifest references a missing layer, the canary will fail nightly queries. Options: targeted cache invalidate + re-prefetch, pin to previous digest, or abort promo.

kelsey: Ok. Ben, do a targeted cache invalidation for shard=0 and retry prefetch once. If it fails again, pin to previous digest and promote only to canary.

ben: Running: `deploybot cache flush --service=search --shard=0 && deploybot prefetch --service=search --shard=0 --run-id=rb-20260321-99`

ci-bot: [echo] run rb-20260321-99 queued on runner-4.

ben: Prefetch finished  still failing: "ERROR Prefetch: manifest checksum mismatch (expected 0x5a3b != actual 0xd2f1) reading s3://artifacts/search/20260321/manifest.json"

kelsey: Cache flush didn't help. Proceed with pin+canary promote. Who will update release note?

ben: I'll pin and promote. Pinning to last-good digest `search:sha256:7788...cc99`. Command: `deploybot promote --service=search --image=sha256:7788cc99 --to=canary --reason="prefetch checksum mismatch" --no-auto-rollout`

deploy-bot: [action] Promotion initiated by ben -> target=canary image=sha256:7788cc99 id=prom-20260321-38 healthchecks=enabled.

ci-bot: [monitor] Healthchecks passed. Traffic to canary shifted to 10%.

sre-oncall: [note] Canary SLA alert cleared. Flagged for follow-up: registry write idempotency and read-after-write verification.

kelsey: Thanks. Ben, please open a follow-up GH issue and tag infra-team to investigate manifest rewrite path and add short read-after-write retry in prefetcher. I'll add a release note: "Canary pinned to previous digest due to artifact prefetch checksum drift; full rollout deferred."

ben: Filed issue https://github.com/redwood/release/issues/501 and a small PR to add a 30s read-after-write retry to prefetcher; linking to the issue.

kelsey: Good. We'll keep prod rollout blocked until we verify stable manifests. Closing thread unless regression appears. :thumbsup:
